title: Hybrid streaming + function-call regression runner
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Build a unified regression runner that validates combined streaming responses and function-call sequences against a reference prompt corpus and a contract manifest. This ticket covers runner orchestration, result fingerprinting, CI job templates, failure triage UX (artifact upload + diff links), and soft rollouts to avoid spamming infra. The runner must support: 1) streaming tokens + incremental tool-call handoffs, 2) function-call ordering and argument fidelity checks, 3) structured-output schema validation, 4) golden/reference prompt tagging for deterministic evaluation, 5) reproducible recordings (seeded PM runs) and deterministic fingerprints for CI gating.
acceptance_criteria: Runner executes a matrix of 200 canonical prompts across streaming + tool-call permutations in under 90 minutes on CI runners
Each test produces a deterministic fingerprint (sha256) of canonical output including token streams and tool-call metadata
CI job fails only for contract regressions with a clear diff link and a one-click artifact download
Structured-output tests validate JSON schema and field-level tolerances (type + regex + numeric delta)
Runner integrates with existing Confluence test catalog and writes results to the central bucket at s3://redwood-regtests/ENG-58901/
progress_updates: 2025-02-06: Ticket created — outlined scope and core invariants; flagged need for a tooling spike to capture streaming events
2025-02-12: Spike completed — prototype records token-level stream events + function-call frames; baseline fingerprinting approach chosen (canonicalize whitespace, stable sort for meta fields)
2025-02-20: Built first CI job template and ran a 50-prompt sanity pass; encountered flakiness for tool-call ordering when parallelized — added sequencing token in recorder
2025-02-25: Eng review with SDK team — agreed on light-weight client shim for consistent event envelope across python/js SDKs; PR opened (github.com/redwood/regrunners/pull/212)
2025-03-01: Canary run on runtime-1.21 completed; 7 regressions surfaced (3 streaming timing-only, 4 schema changes). Next: remediation plan and flaky test quarantine
notes: Design trade-off: prefer deterministic fingerprinting over fuzzy similarity for CI gating to reduce false positives; allow a separate 'soft-regression' path that flags but does not fail
Long-term: coordinate with Dedicated team to run larger matrix against hardware variants (A100, H100) — will be a follow-up project
Consider adding a lightweight visual diff UI for token-stream regressions in the Console
